verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs state that an llms.txt index is available for AI agents, and a probe confirms https://docs.datadoghq.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and calls itself the canonical entry point. Individual pages such as the API reference, OpenTelemetry and MCP Server docs also offer markdown versions explicitly labeled for AI agents. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively in practice.
